reason: The initial P1/P2 suite compares direct numeric input access on shared training labels. Strict information access additionally requires deleting all held-target responses from the P1 training objective. This clarification was fixed before any strict-permission experiment or test inspection.
common_supervised_training: Original train rows excluding every target appearing in original validation or test; same supervised labels for P0, P1 and P2
P0: Function annotations and known context covariates, no target control expression and no held-target response labels
P1: P0 plus allowed non-targeting baseline; no response of any held validation/test target in training or input
P2: Same supervised objective as P1 plus direct numeric responses from original training rows in the other contexts of held targets; held target-condition response never included
normalization_and_global_mean: Fitted using common supervised training rows only
model_selection: Original selection-validation target subset; calibration subset remains unused for selection
